source.contract: HardwareProfile -> scalar | avx2 | avx512; returns hw.vectorTier unchanged

overlay.contract: Bool + String -> String; denies unadmitted profiles to scalar and admits only avx2/avx512 strings

roleDecision.reason: The overlay adds a profile-admission guard and an unknown-tier fallback that the TypeScript getter does not perform; it is a safety-policy probe, not a replacement for the source symbol.
roleDecision.nextAction: Keep the overlay in the test package. Do not copy it into packages/fungi/products/galerina or promote the economics queue row until a typed HardwareProfile lowering, exact differential vectors and a fresh owner admission exist.

decision: The overlay inventory is now distinguished from product twins. Existing test overlays provide advisory decision probes; they do not satisfy product conversion, exact parity or admission.
